title: PQC vendor claims
description: Curated, dated claims about the post-quantum roadmap of the vendors and dependencies a fleet cannot fix locally (the delegated / blocked-external class). A declared reference document (scope-ref): imported with no assessment and published whole, so a review is a successor version with a higher `version`, never an edit; readers take the latest. Claims are as-reviewed on `last_reviewed` and are re-verified before external use. Fleet counts (repositories depending on a vendor, blocked-external repositories) are derived by the reader from recorded facts and are never stored here.

id.description: Unique within the document (the recording service checks).

packages.description: Dependencies that carry this vendor's crypto into the fleet, matched against recorded dependency names. Empty: reached only through a provider, toolchain or service, not a package.

claim.description: What the vendor ships or has announced, as reviewed.

watch.description: The signal that would move the status.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed the claim (team or role).

vendor_class.description: provider: a crypto provider or toolchain (OpenSSL, Go, JDK). library: a crypto library packages depend on. ecosystem: a signing or identity ecosystem (Sigstore, GnuPG, Kerberos). service: a hosted service the fleet calls. internal: the organization's own shared services.

status.description: available: PQC algorithms shipped and usable. partial: some (e.g. key exchange but not signatures). in_progress: announced or in preview. none: no public roadmap.
